name: mizan-ai
description: Mizan AI — Voice-First AI Financial & Business Management Assistant for Ethiopian Small Businesses

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
